gild.sense_en: covered with a very thin layer of gold

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, technical word for a metal object with a gold coating; no literary feel.
Older adjective form of the same idea; common for picture frames and book edges.
Only says the colour or material is gold; does not tell you it is a thin surface layer.

hilt.sense_en: the handle of a sword, where you hold it
hilt.tip_ko: idiom: to the hilt = 최대한, 끝까지 (mortgaged to the hilt).

synonyms.nuance: General word for the part of any tool you hold; hilt is only for swords and daggers.
The part where the hand actually closes; more technical, used for guns, rackets, swords.

weathercock.sense_en: a metal figure of a rooster on a roof that turns to show wind direction
weathercock.tip_ko: 비유적으로 '줏대 없이 이리저리 바뀌는 사람'을 뜻하기도 한다.

synonyms.nuance: The general term for any wind-direction pointer, whatever its shape.
A cloth tube at airports; practical, never decorative.

lest.sense_en: that (something bad might happen); used after words of fear
lest.tip_ko: lest 뒤에는 not을 쓰지 않는다. fearing lest people should think = 사람들이 ~라고 생각할까 봐.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday modern equivalent; lest sounds formal, old or literary.
synonyms.example: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

synonyms.nuance: Also formal but more transparent; stresses the worry itself.
synonyms.example: He whispered for fear that they would hear.

synonyms.nuance: Neutral purpose clause; needs an explicit negative, unlike lest.
synonyms.example: Write it down so that you don't forget.

crying-for-the-moon.sense_en: to want something impossible to get

synonyms.nuance: Plain, literal version with no image; less playful.
About pursuing an unrealistic plan over time, not a single wish.
synonyms.example: Opening a café in space is a pipe dream.

synonyms.nuance: Hopeful and gentle; suggests hoping, not demanding or crying.
synonyms.example: She wished on a star for snow.

mutter.sense_en: said quietly and unclearly, often in a complaining mood

synonyms.nuance: Unclear speech from shyness or tiredness; mutter adds grumbling or irritation.
Soft and gentle, often pleasant or loving; not grumpy.
Clearly complaining, may be audible; focus is on the complaint, not the volume.

gaze.sense_en: looked at something steadily for a long time, with wonder or thought
gaze.tip_ko: gaze at, stare at처럼 전치사 at과 함께 쓴다.

synonyms.nuance: Also long, but often rude, blank or shocked; gaze is soft and admiring.
A very quick look — the opposite duration.
Staring with the mouth open in surprise; slightly comic.

pinafore.sense_en: a sleeveless apron-like dress worn over clothes to keep them clean

synonyms.nuance: Covers only the front, tied at the back; mainly for cooking or work.
Loose, with sleeves, worn by artists or children while painting.

severe.tip_ko: severe는 '심각한'(severe pain) 뜻이 흔하지만, 사람 표정에 쓰면 '엄한'이다.

synonyms.nuance: Very close; stern focuses on a disapproving face or voice, often of a parent or teacher.
About rules and behaviour, not appearance.
Gloomy and serious, often because of bad news, not disapproval.

come-to-the-point.sense_en: to say the important thing directly, without wasting words

synonyms.nuance: Same meaning, more common in modern speech; often an impatient command.
Informal, American, from film-making; very direct.
Stresses avoiding hesitation or hints.
synonyms.example: I won't beat around the bush.

courtship.sense_en: the period or way of trying to win someone's love
courtship.tip_ko: court가 동사로 '구애하다'라는 뜻이 있어서 courtship이 나왔다.

synonyms.nuance: Modern, casual; courtship sounds old-fashioned and formal, often aimed at marriage.
synonyms.example: They've been dating for a year.

synonyms.nuance: The actions of trying to win someone; literary and a bit playful.
The love affair itself, not specifically the effort to win someone.

attachment.sense_en: a feeling of love or strong liking for someone
attachment.tip_ko: 이메일 '첨부 파일'로만 알기 쉽지만, 사람·장소에 대한 '애착'이라는 뜻도 흔하다.

synonyms.nuance: Warm, gentle liking; attachment suggests being emotionally tied, harder to let go.
synonyms.example: She spoke of him with affection.

synonyms.nuance: Intense but short, foolish passion — close to what the other swallows think.
Mild, pleasant liking; weaker than attachment.

coquette.sense_en: a woman who flirts with many men without serious feelings
coquette.tip_ko: 프랑스어에서 온 말로 끝 음절에 강세: ko-KET.

synonyms.nuance: Modern, neutral, for any gender; coquette is old-fashioned and French-sounding.
Stresses leading someone on and then refusing; more negative.

flirt.sense_en: behaving playfully as if attracted to someone, not seriously

synonyms.nuance: Playful joking that may include mocking; not necessarily romantic.
Serious, formal attempt to win love; flirting is light and uncommitted.
synonyms.example: He courted her for a year.

synonyms.nuance: Informal, direct attempt to start a romance; often unwelcome.
synonyms.example: Some guy hit on her at the bar.

curtsey.sense_en: a woman's polite greeting made by bending the knees
curtsey.tip_ko: curtsy로도 쓴다. 갈대가 바람에 굽는 모습을 인사로 비유한 것.

synonyms.nuance: Bending from the waist; traditionally the man's greeting.
A small head movement only; casual, not ceremonial.

domestic.sense_en: liking home life and staying at home
domestic.tip_ko: domestic flight(국내선)의 '국내의' 뜻과 구별. 사람에게 쓰면 '가정적인'.

synonyms.nuance: British: cosy and home-loving; American: plain or unattractive — be careful.
Clear and informal; no other meanings to confuse.
Noun, informal: a person who prefers staying home.

trifle-with.sense_en: to treat someone's feelings carelessly, as if they did not matter
trifle-with.tip_ko: trifle은 명사로 '하찮은 것' 또는 영국식 디저트 이름이기도 하다.

synonyms.nuance: Similar; also used for ideas you consider without commitment.
synonyms.example: She toyed with the idea of moving.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and broader; 'play with someone's feelings' is the modern phrase.
Making someone believe you love them when you don't.
synonyms.example: He led her on for months.

put-up.sense_en: to stay somewhere for the night
put-up.tip_ko: 오늘날 put up은 보통 put someone up(재워 주다) 또는 put up with(참다)로 쓴다.

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word; 'put up' in this sense is old-fashioned.
synonyms.example: We stayed at a small hotel.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; usually paying to live in someone's house.
Very informal; sleep somewhere casually, often for free.
synonyms.example: Can I crash at your place?

alight.tip_ko: formal하게 '(차에서) 내리다'도 된다: alight from the bus.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, neutral; used for planes as well as birds.
Sit on a narrow edge or branch; focuses on the resting position.
synonyms.example: A crow perched on the fence.

synonyms.nuance: Come to rest after moving around; softer, gradual.

drench.tip_ko: get drenched = (비에) 흠뻑 젖다. soaked보다 약간 문어적이다.

synonyms.nuance: Very close; soak also means leaving something in liquid for a long time.
Plain everyday word; says nothing about how much.
Only a few drops or a quick spray, not a full soaking.

lofty.tip_ko: lofty ideals(고상한 이상), lofty manner(거만한 태도)처럼 추상적으로도 쓴다.

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word, no grand feeling.
Much taller than surrounding things; can feel threatening.
Measures distance from the ground; not about looking grand.

courtier.sense_en: a person who attends a king or prince at the royal court

synonyms.nuance: Anyone who serves or accompanies someone; not necessarily noble.
Stresses empty praise — which courtiers were often known for.
Names high social rank, not the job of serving at court.

cannot-choose-but.sense_en: cannot do anything except; have no other possibility
cannot-choose-but.tip_ko: 원문의 chose는 choose를 잘못 찍은 것으로, 다른 판본에는 cannot choose but weep로 나온다.

synonyms.nuance: Modern everyday version; followed by -ing.
Neutral, often about practical decisions, not feelings.
synonyms.example: We had no choice but to wait.

synonyms.nuance: Formal, older; followed by a bare verb.

coarse.sense_en: rough to the touch, from hard work
coarse.tip_ko: course(과정)와 발음이 같다. 사람 말투에 쓰면 '상스러운'.

synonyms.nuance: General word for an uneven surface; coarse suggests a thick, grainy texture.
Specifically hard, thick skin from repeated rubbing or work.
Cracked and sore from cold or wind.

seamstress.sense_en: a woman whose job is sewing

synonyms.nuance: Makes fitted suits and coats, traditionally a man; a skilled trade.
Designs and makes women's dresses; a seamstress may only do the sewing.

embroider.sense_en: sewing decorative patterns onto cloth with coloured thread
embroider.tip_ko: 비유적으로 '(이야기를) 부풀리다'도 된다: embroider the truth.

synonyms.nuance: Any sewing with a needle; not necessarily decorative.
General word for joining or making with needle and thread.
Making fabric from yarn with two long needles; a different craft.

pedestal.sense_en: the base that a statue stands on
pedestal.tip_ko: put someone on a pedestal = 누군가를 지나치게 우러러보다.

synonyms.nuance: A tall pillar; the pedestal is the block right under the statue.
General word for the bottom support of anything.
Technical term for a flat square block under a statue or column.

embalm.sense_en: treated a dead body with chemicals or spices so it would not decay

synonyms.nuance: Specifically the ancient Egyptian method of drying and wrapping.
General word for keeping anything from decaying, including food.

withered.sense_en: dried up and shrunken, like dead leaves

synonyms.nuance: Soft and drooping from lack of water; may still recover. Withered is dry and past saving.
Stresses shrinking and wrinkling as it dries.
Lost colour, not necessarily dried out.
Neutral everyday word; slumber is poetic and peaceful.
A short sleep during the day.
Light, often unplanned sleep.
synonyms.example: He dozed off in front of the TV.

thimble.sense_en: a small metal cap worn on the finger to push a needle when sewing

synonyms.nuance: Generic, descriptive term; not traditional for sewing.
The sewing tool itself, which the thimble helps to push.

in-high-spirits.tip_ko: spirits는 복수형. 반대는 in low spirits(풀이 죽어).

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and calmer; high spirits adds energy and excitement.
synonyms.example: She's in a good mood today.

synonyms.nuance: Informal; extreme happiness, often after great news.
synonyms.example: He's been on cloud nine since the wedding.

synonyms.nuance: Formal adjective for sudden, strong joy.

prospect.sense_en: the idea of something that will probably happen soon

synonyms.nuance: What you believe will happen; prospect is the event itself as you look ahead.
General view of the future, e.g. economy or weather.
The feeling of excitement while waiting.

steeple.sense_en: a tall pointed tower on a church

synonyms.nuance: Just the pointed top part; steeple is the whole tower with spire.
Any tall structure, pointed or not.
The part of a tower where bells hang.

distinguished.tip_ko: 원래 뜻 distinguish(구별하다)에서 '남들과 구별될 만큼 뛰어난'.

synonyms.nuance: Famous and respected in a profession; about reputation, not looks.
Calm and serious in manner; distinguished adds importance and status.
Simply well known, good or bad.

commission.sense_en: a task you ask someone to do for you, like buying or delivering something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a small trip to buy or deliver something.
synonyms.example: I have some errands to run.

synonyms.nuance: Anything you ask for; does not imply a trip or task.
A task given officially, at work or school.

cataract.sense_en: a large, steep waterfall or rapids on a river
cataract.tip_ko: 의학 용어로는 '백내장'. 나일강의 급류 구간들을 First, Second ... Cataract라고 부른다.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; cataract is literary or geographic, and suggests great force.
Fast, rough water flowing over rocks, without a big drop.
Used in names of big waterfalls.

couch.sense_en: lies down to rest (said of an animal)
couch.tip_ko: '소파'라는 명사 couch와 다른, 옛 문어체 동사. river-horse는 하마(hippopotamus)를 말한다.

synonyms.nuance: Bending low on the legs, ready to move; couch here is lying at rest.
synonyms.example: The cat crouched, ready to jump.

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday verb for resting flat.
synonyms.example: The dog lay by the fire.

synonyms.nuance: Waiting hidden, often with bad intent.

bulrush.sense_en: a tall plant with long stems that grows in water

synonyms.nuance: Similar tall water grass, often hollow; the Swallow's love in this story.
A specific Nile plant used by Egyptians to make paper.
American name for a water plant with a brown sausage-like head.

garret.sense_en: a small, poor room at the top of a house, under the roof

synonyms.nuance: The space under a roof, often used for storage; garret is a room where a poor person lives.
Space under a roof; today often a stylish open apartment.

grate.sense_en: the metal frame in a fireplace that holds the coal or wood
grate.tip_ko: 동사 grate는 '(치즈 등을) 갈다'. great와 발음이 같다.

synonyms.nuance: The whole opening in the wall where a fire burns.
The floor of the fireplace; literary symbol of home.
A closed metal box for heating or cooking.

tumbler.sense_en: a flat-bottomed drinking glass with no handle or stem
tumbler.tip_ko: tumble(넘어지다)에서 온 말. 옛날엔 바닥이 둥글어 세울 수 없는 잔을 가리켰다.

synonyms.nuance: General word for any drinking glass.
A cup without handle, often plastic or for science labs.
A glass or metal cup with a stem and base; grand or old-fashioned.

alas.sense_en: an old word showing sadness or regret

synonyms.nuance: Modern neutral adverb; no dramatic feeling.
Modern, a bit warmer, shows sympathy.

pluck.sense_en: pull out something quickly with the fingers

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, neutral; pluck suggests a small, quick, precise pull.
Take off flowers or fruit; gentler.
Violent and rough, often damaging.

dart.sense_en: moved suddenly and quickly in one direction
dart.tip_ko: 명사 dart는 다트 놀이의 화살. 움직임이 화살처럼 빠르다는 느낌.

synonyms.nuance: Move quickly, usually running, often because you are in a hurry.
Move very fast in a straight line; stresses speed.
synonyms.example: A rocket shot into the sky.

synonyms.nuance: Fly lightly and quickly from place to place, not in one direction.

appreciate.sense_en: recognized and valued for one's talent
appreciate.tip_ko: '감사하다' 뜻으로만 알기 쉽지만 '진가를 알아보다'가 원래 뜻.

synonyms.nuance: Officially acknowledge achievement, often publicly.
synonyms.example: Her work was recognized with an award.

synonyms.nuance: Consider important; less about discovery of talent.
Feel respect and liking; the admirer's feeling, not the result.

hold.sense_en: the space inside a ship where goods are carried
hold.tip_ko: 동사 hold(잡다)와 달리 명사로 '선창'. haul ... out of the hold = 화물칸에서 끌어 올리다.

synonyms.nuance: Modern term, also for planes and spacecraft.
A floor of a ship, especially the open top one.

bid-good-bye.tip_ko: I am come = I have come의 옛 표현.

synonyms.nuance: Plain modern version; bid sounds formal and literary.
Formal; leaving someone politely.
synonyms.example: He took leave of his hosts.

synonyms.nuance: Go with someone to the place they leave from.
synonyms.example: We saw her off at the airport.

swoop.sense_en: flew down fast in a curve

synonyms.nuance: Straight down, steep and fast; swoop is curved and sweeping.
synonyms.example: The hawk dived at the rabbit.

synonyms.nuance: Smooth, slow flight without flapping.
Sudden jump to catch prey; used for cats more than birds.

make-merry.sense_en: to enjoy yourself with food, drink and fun

synonyms.nuance: Enjoy for a special reason; neutral.
Informal verb; modern and casual.
Literary; loud, lively, often wild enjoyment.

listlessly.sense_en: without energy or interest, as if tired or ill
listlessly.tip_ko: list(목록)와는 무관. 옛말 list = '원하다'에서 '원하는 것이 없는'.

synonyms.nuance: Because of tiredness; listless also suggests no interest at all.
By choice, relaxed; listless is not a choice.
Not caring at all; emotional, not physical weakness.

glisten.sense_en: shining because the surface is wet or icy

synonyms.nuance: Many small bright flashes, like jewels; glisten is a wet shine.
Lively flashes of light; also used for eyes and personality.
A steady soft shine from a clean or polished surface.

eaves.sense_en: the lower edges of a roof that stick out over the walls
eaves.tip_ko: eavesdrop(엿듣다)는 처마 밑에서 몰래 듣는 데서 나온 말.

synonyms.nuance: The whole top of a building; eaves are only its overhanging edges.
Any part that sticks out over something below.

leaden.sense_en: made of lead, a heavy grey metal
leaden.tip_ko: 금속 lead는 /lɛd/(레드)로 읽는다. 동사 lead(이끌다) /lid/와 구별.

synonyms.nuance: Noun used like an adjective (a lead pipe); the plain, modern way to say it.
Leaden also often means heavy and slow in a figurative way.
Leaden skies means dull, dark grey clouds.

shabby.sense_en: looking old, worn and in poor condition

synonyms.nuance: Damaged by long use; neutral, no judgement.
Informal; untidy and dirty, usually a person's appearance.
Buildings or areas in bad repair.

proclamation.sense_en: an official public announcement by someone in authority
proclamation.tip_ko: 새가 죽지 못하게 포고를 내리겠다는 시장의 말은 풍자다.

synonyms.nuance: Any public statement; not necessarily official or grand.
An official order that has the force of law.
A formal statement of a position or fact.

foundry.sense_en: a factory where metal is melted and shaped

synonyms.nuance: A workshop where metal is heated and hammered, like a blacksmith's.
Extracts metal from ore by heating; the step before a foundry.
Factory that processes materials, e.g. steel, paper, grain.

evermore.tip_ko: for evermore 형태로 성경·찬송가에서 자주 보인다.

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern word; evermore is poetic or religious.
Formal; without any end, often used with 'grateful'.
Every time; not specifically about endless future.
